newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late palm olein stable, trade thin.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late palm olein stable, trade thin.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were mostly stable in late trading on Friday after early falls, with demand remaining weak amid declines in Malaysia, traders said.
They said palm olein was quoted at 1,440-45 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, unchanged from the opening but down from Thursday's close of 1,445-50 rupiah, but trades were also done at 1,435.
The traders said crude palm oil was on offer at 1,240 rupiah/kg in the North Sumatran capital of Medan after it was last done at 1,245 rupiah and 1,247 rupiah at a tender.
"Prices are weak because of poor buying interest," one trader said. "Falls in Malaysia also kept sentiment weak."

The traders said buyers were being cautious due to the on-going general election campaign, especially after a clash between supporters of the ruling Golkar party and construction workers in a south Jakarta suburb on Thursday.
"Players do not want to keep a high level of stocks in case of any incidents during the campaign," one trader said. "They have just been buying for their immediate needs."
Indonesians go to the polls on May 19, with the Golkar party widely expected to emerge victorious.
